specs.name: Repository audit and baseline
specs.stop_condition: If any module is unclassified, the phase fails.

deliverables: Unified Tick, Candle, Order, Fill, Position and portfolio models
specs.name: Core data contracts
specs.stop_condition: Any missing core entity blocks the phase.
success_criteria: All core entities pass schema tests

specs.name: Portfolio and order state engine
specs.stop_condition: Any broker/internal state mismatch fails the phase.

specs.name: Risk engine
specs.stop_condition: Any risk-engine bypass immediately fails the phase.
success_criteria: Risk veto always overrides a trade

specs.name: Broker abstraction layer
specs.stop_condition: Broker-specific logic in a strategy fails the phase.
success_criteria: Broker swaps do not affect strategies

specs.name: Market data pipeline
specs.stop_condition: Any unvalidated data entering the pipeline fails the phase.

specs.name: Backtest engine
specs.stop_condition: Any backtest/live divergence fails the phase.

specs.name: Strategy research lab
specs.stop_condition: Promotion of any untested strategy fails the phase.

specs.name: Knowledge and RAG engine
specs.stop_condition: Use of unverified knowledge in trading fails the phase.

specs.name: Multi-agent system
specs.stop_condition: Any agent bypassing its schema fails the phase.
success_criteria: Agent outputs are deterministic and structured

specs.name: CEO decision engine
specs.stop_condition: Any non-reproducible decision fails the phase.

specs.name: Broker integration live readiness
specs.stop_condition: Any unverified order execution fails the phase.

specs.name: Paper trading system
specs.stop_condition: Any behavior mismatch fails the phase.
specs.success_criteria: Paper behavior is demonstrably identical to the live engine

specs.name: Alerting, UI and voice
specs.stop_condition: Any missed critical event fails the phase.

specs.name: End-to-end system validation
specs.stop_condition: Any critical failure fails the phase.

specs.name: Controlled live deployment readiness
specs.stop_condition: Any unresolved risk blocks live deployment.
